name: @spier/cds
description: SPiER's CDS Hooks 2.0 service on Cloudflare Workers — JSON only, on its own origin. No SPA, no Static Assets, no IG.

scripts.deploy: test -n "$CI" || { echo 'Refusing to deploy outside CI — deploy.yml is the one place this Worker ships from. Push to main, or set CI=true to override.' >&2; exit 1; }; npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.verify: npm --prefix ../.. run copy-fhir && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:csp && npm run test
